validation_scope: English speech captured from a separate player UID with no screen subtitles, actual Chinese output, and stop without late-callback restart.
Japanese model download, actual native model reload without network, and Japanese-to-Chinese translation offline.
Prior unit, voice, UI and real Google translation checks.
limitations: Real user phone and Bluetooth headset have not been tested.
No claim of measured Japanese/Korean speech accuracy or a fixed translation latency.
Player must permit AudioPlaybackCapture; language models require network on first preparation.
Bounded queue can reject new speech during sustained translation overload with a visible warning.
